title: Make Maruchan Chicken Ramen (Microwave Bowl)
summary: Prepare a packet of Maruchan chicken ramen: get the packet and a bowl, add water and noodles, cook, stir in the seasoning, and serve.
source: open-set draft from 8 frames + the person's description 'making Ramen'

nodes.name: Get ramen packet from drawer
nodes.instruction_novice: Open the drawer and take out one packet of ramen. Close the drawer when you're done.
nodes.end_state: The person is holding the ramen packet and the drawer is closed.

checks.question: Is this step done: Get ramen packet from drawer?

nodes.name: Read package directions
nodes.instruction_novice: Flip the packet over and check the cooking directions on the back. Note how much water and time it needs.
nodes.end_state: The back of the packet with its directions is facing the camera.

checks.question: Is this step done: Read package directions?

nodes.name: Get a microwave-safe bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Pick a bowl big enough for the noodles and water. Make sure it's microwave-safe if you'll use the microwave.
nodes.end_state: The empty bowl is in hand or on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Get a microwave-safe bowl?

nodes.name: Open packet and remove seasoning
nodes.instruction_novice: Tear open the packet and take out the small seasoning sachet. Set the sachet aside.
nodes.end_state: The open packet and the seasoning sachet are on the counter separately.

checks.question: Is this step done: Open packet and remove seasoning?

nodes.name: Place noodles in bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the noodle block into the bowl. You can break it in half if it doesn't fit.
nodes.end_state: The dry noodle block sits in the bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Place noodles in bowl?

nodes.name: Add two cups water
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour about two cups of water over the noodles until they are covered.
nodes.end_state: The noodles are submerged in water in the bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add two cups water?

nodes.name: Microwave noodles
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the bowl in the microwave and cook on high for about five minutes. Watch it so the water doesn't boil over.
nodes.end_state: The microwave is running with the bowl inside.

checks.question: Is this step done: Microwave noodles?

nodes.name: Remove bowl carefully
nodes.instruction_novice: Use an oven mitt or towel, because the bowl will be hot. Set it on the counter.
nodes.end_state: The steaming bowl of soft noodles is on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Remove bowl carefully?

nodes.name: Stir in seasoning packet
nodes.instruction_novice: Tear open the seasoning sachet and sprinkle it over the noodles. Stir well until it dissolves.
nodes.end_state: The broth looks evenly golden and the empty sachet is set aside.

checks.question: Is this step done: Stir in seasoning packet?

nodes.name: Let cool and serve
nodes.instruction_novice: Let the ramen sit for a minute to cool a little. Then grab a fork or chopsticks and enjoy.
nodes.end_state: The bowl of ramen sits ready with a utensil in it.

checks.question: Is this step done: Let cool and serve?

nodes.name: Discard wrappers
nodes.instruction_novice: Throw the empty packet and seasoning wrapper in the trash.
nodes.end_state: The counter is clear of ramen wrappers.

checks.question: Is this step done: Discard wrappers?
